rows.description: A curated list of awesome unoffical PC Ports.

SpartanPort: unofficial PC port of God of War III Remastered (PS4) for Windows and Linux (AppImage). Original x86-64 code runs directly on the CPU with a custom runtime; graphics use shadPS4's Vulkan video core. Launcher, in-game menu, controller icons and up to 240 FPS. Requires your own game dump. No game files included.

Native PC port (Linux/Windows) of inFAMOUS Second Son (PS4, CUSA00223) — in development, playable; runs your own game dump; no game or firmware files included. Motion sensor emulation. | Port nativo para PC de inFAMOUS Second Son (em desenvolvimento) — usa o seu próprio dump.
